_comment: Reading practice «خواندن نوشته‌ها»: realistic pieces of paper and screens. Every name, number, date, amount and organisation here is made up; no paper copies a real letterhead. 'lines' are shown as on the paper (English, left to right) with the exact Farsi of each line; a question is answered by tapping the line it names ('line' counts from 1). A paper that shows money, medicine or personal details carries a note and is flagged safetyCritical.
